notes: Translated from OVAL's validation file permission_prohibition, which OVAL's SHACL validator must reject. Changed: rules named; Rule types added, each the range of the edge that holds it; conflict declared. The nesting is as authored. OVAL's other files that nest a Rule under an edge outside its domain reach the same check (conformance/external/README.md § Triage of what was not translated). OVAL keeps no result beyond the rejection.

expected_rejection.why: The Permission <http://example.com/policy:1010#use> holds a Prohibition through odrl:prohibition, whose domain is a Policy (Vocabulary §3.10.2). Normalisation rejects a Rule edge outside its domain in stage 1 (odrl-compound-to-atomic-normalization.md §3): read as authored the Prohibition would be dropped, because root atoms come from the Policy's own Rule edges only. W1 rejects the policy.

oval_expected.result: invalid: OVAL's SHACL validator must reject it
